xna-type.name: SpriteBatch
xna-type.summary: Enables a group of sprites to be drawn using the same settings.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class, which enables a group of sprites to be drawn using the same settings.

parameters.parameter: The graphics device where sprites will be drawn.

property.name: GraphicsDevice
property.summary: Gets the graphics device associated with this SpriteBatch.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the object is disposed.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets or sets the name of this sprite batch.

property.name: Tag
property.summary: Gets or sets an object that uniquely identifies this sprite batch.

method.name: Begin
method.summary: Begins a sprite batch operation using the specified sort, blend, sampler, depth stencil, rasterizer state objects, plus a custom effect and a 2D transformation matrix. Passing null for any of the state objects selects the default default state objects (BlendState.AlphaBlend, DepthStencilState.None, RasterizerState.CullCounterClockwise, SamplerState.LinearClamp). Passing a null effect selects the default SpriteBatch Class shader.

overload.summary: Prepares the graphics device for drawing sprites with specified blending, sorting, and render state options.

parameters.parameter: Blending options to use when rendering.
Sorting options to use when rendering.
Rendering state options.
A matrix to apply to position, rotation, scale, and depth data passed to Draw .

overload.remarks: This method must be called before any calls to Draw . When all the sprites have been drawn, call End . Begin sets the following render states: CullMode DepthBufferEnable AlphaBlendEnable AlphaTestEnable AlphaBlendOperation SourceBlend DestinationBlend SeparateAlphaBlendEnabled AlphaFunction ReferenceAlpha Begin sets the following sampler states: AddressU AddressV MagFilter MinFilter MipFilter MipMapLevelOfDetailBias MaxMipLevel If Begin is called with SaveStateMode set to None , then these states must be reset by the caller if they are used elsewhere. Calling Begin with SaveStateMode set to SaveState will reset these values properly, but may adversely affect performance. Use transformMatrix to apply the same transformation to all sprites drawn by this SpriteBatch . This matrix can be any combination of translation, scaling, or rotation operations. This matrix is applied to the position, rotation, scale, and depth values provided to Draw .

When SaveStateMode is set to None , the caller must reset the render and sampler states if they are used elsewhere.

method.name: Draw
method.summary: Adds a sprite to the batch of sprites to be rendered, specifying the texture, destination rectangle, and color tint.

overload.summary: Adds a sprite to the batch of sprites to be rendered, specifying the texture, destination rectangle, and color tint.
